paper_title: HeLIOS: The Superfluid Helium Ultralight Dark Matter Detector
coupling_convention: g_{B-L}, dimensionless vector coupling, as plotted on y-axis
notes: HeLIOS is a superfluid helium optomechanical UDM detector. This is a PROJECTION/sensitivity paper (prototype demonstration, no actual exclusion limit set - thermal-noise-limited readout not yet achieved). Fig. 1 shows projected sensitivity for BOTH scalar UDM coupling to electron mass (d_me, ScalarElectron) and vector UDM coupling to B-L number (g_B-L, VectorBL). Per hint chose VectorBL, but paper equally covers ScalarElectron. No numerical table of the projected exclusion curves is provided - only figure axis ranges: vector panel spans g_B-L ~1e-26 to 1e-16 over mass ~1-50 peV (1e-12 to 5e-11 eV); scalar panel spans d_me ~1e-7 to 1e7 over 3-50 peV. Curve values cannot be reliably digitized from text alone, so no data points extracted. Local DM density assumed 0.4 GeV/cm^3. | selector: figure_vision (sole candidate) | Vision: Right panel of Figure 1 is the VectorBL (g_{B-L}) sensitivity plot (x = vector boson mass in peV, y = g_{B-L}, 1e-26 to 1e-16). Provided axis calibration (y 1e-7 to 1e7, x 3-55 peV) matches the LEFT scalar (d_me) panel, not the vector panel; I used the actual right-panel axes per the VectorBL hint. This is a projected sensitivity (tabletop proposal, tau=1hr) not an exclusion. The traced lower boundary is the envelope of the HeLIOS red + pressurize region, with sharp resonance dips (deepest ~5e-24 near 4 peV) at the ten lowest mechanical modes rising to off-resonance humps. 1 kHz Compton frequency corresponds to ~4.14 peV. Point values are approximate reads from a jagged, partly log-narrow feature; hence lower extraction confidence. | Calibration: No calibration needed | [COUPLING REVIEW] axis 'dimensionless scalar coupling d_me' implies ScalarElectron but classified VectorBL (cross-family contradiction — flagged, not overridden)
